'''Rille Nuder''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] representative of the [[Imperial Environmental Preservation & Refocusing Authority]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rille Nuder was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
